extracted_decision.summary: On autopilot, plan through the Brain first and then implement automatically without pausing for a separate plan approval.
extracted_decision.rationale: The Manager wants end-to-end autonomy while keeping the Brain's planning step in the loop.
alternatives: Pause for explicit plan approval before implementing
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Fewer human checkpoints and less token churn, at the cost of the Manager not reviewing the plan before code lands.
